alt: An annotated screenshot of the Wesley Health Centers (JWCH) official homepage. Red boxes highlight their 'After Hours' contact numbers (1-866-733-5924 and 1-562-867-7999), and yellow annotation notes document that dialing these numbers during both regular business hours and after-hours returns Verizon's 'Announcement 3' suspended line intercept messages.

full_text:
Image Annotations:
1. Red box around 'After Hours' numbers: '(866) 733-5924 or (562) 867-7999'.
2. Left yellow box: 'During business hours: Your call cannot be completed... ANNOUNCEMENT 3. After Hours: Your call cannot be completed... ANNOUNCEMENT 3.'
3. Right yellow box: 'Well since the phone lines are completely down I might as well take a nice virtual stroll...' pointing to 'Take a Tour at Wesley'.
